title: Elderly woman dies after hernia surgery at Kanhangad hospital; family alleges medical negligence

ai.summary: A 70-year-old woman died after hernia surgery at Kanhangad District Hospital, with her family alleging medical negligence; DYFI activists protested the hospital, demanding an investigation.

facts.claim: A 70-year-old woman died at the Kanhangad District Hospital following a hernia surgery
